findings.summary: Reduced-motion preference does not stop long-running decorative animation.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion evaluate probe matched prefers-reduced-motion: reduce but still found two running animations with 14s and 22s durations.
findings.suggestedFix: Inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, remove non-essential animation or reduce it to a non-moving state.

findings.summary: High-contrast preference retains known low-contrast text and controls.
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast: more screenshot is visually unchanged, while Lighthouse identifies forum metadata down to 3.94:1, green labels at 2.77:1, and links indistinguishable from surrounding text.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide higher-contrast tokens under prefers-contrast: more and forced-colors-safe control styling.

findings.summary: Route and state changes are abrupt rather than using view transitions.
findings.evidence: Rendered CSS contained no view-transition usage, and the representative forum, thread, and login route states swap directly.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for navigation, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Sticky navigation does not react to scroll state.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no scroll-state query or animation timeline; the captured page chrome remains a fixed, static band rather than giving position/progress feedback.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrained scroll-state-aware header treatment or progress cue where it helps orientation.

findings.summary: Dropdown positioning relies on legacy/custom behavior rather than anchor positioning.
findings.evidence: The site exposes dropdown navigation, but CSS inspection found zero anchor-name, position-anchor, or position-try declarations.
findings.suggestedFix: Use CSS anchor positioning with fallback positions for dropdowns and edge-aware menus.

findings.summary: Promotional chrome and notices displace the primary forum content on mobile.
findings.evidence: At 360x800, a 107px animated ad plus two large notice cards consume roughly the first 450px; the first actual forum row begins below the initial viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer or collapse promotional content, cap notice height, and keep the primary forum task visible in the first viewport.

findings.summary: Interactive menus and disclosures are custom rather than semantic platform primitives.
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found no dialog, popover, or details elements despite dropdown/navigation disclosure controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover/details/dialog according to modality and preserve declarative light-dismiss and focus behavior.

findings.summary: Non-content chrome dominates the first mobile viewport.
findings.evidence: The mobile screenshot shows advertising and operational notices before the forum directory, leaving little room for the user’s core content.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce persistent framing and move secondary promotion after primary content.

findings.summary: Responsive behavior is viewport-only rather than component-aware.
findings.evidence: The page adapts at 360px, but rendered CSS contains no @container rules and the probe found zero size containers.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container queries for reused forum rows, side panels, and navigation components.

findings.summary: Several interactive targets are too small for reliable touch use.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails target-size for footer links at 20px high; the DOM probe also found the notice dismiss target at 17x21px and a 22px-wide disclosure target.
findings.suggestedFix: Give controls at least a 24x24 CSS pixel target with adequate spacing, preferably larger on touch layouts.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint is outside the good range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 4.3s (score 0.42), although the trace run measured 1.58s, indicating materially variable load performance.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP resource, reduce early asset contention, and validate under representative mobile throttling.

findings.summary: Resource delivery is dominated by large images and render-blocking styles.
findings.evidence: HAR records 6.71MB transferred, including 6.44MB of images; several multi-megabyte images lack cache headers. Lighthouse estimates 760ms savings from render-blocking resources.
findings.suggestedFix: Resize/defer images, add durable cache headers, subset fonts, and remove or defer non-critical blocking CSS/scripts.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused CSS and JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 55KiB unused CSS with about 86% waste and 38KiB unused JS in core-compiled.js.
findings.suggestedFix: Split template CSS/JS by route and load optional behavior conditionally.

findings.summary: Some images have no text alternative.
findings.evidence: The images primitive reports 7 of 48 images without alt text.
findings.suggestedFix: Add meaningful alt text or explicit empty alt for decorative images.

findings.summary: Text and essential UI fail minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails color contrast for repeated forum metadata (3.94–4.21:1) and green labels (2.77:1), and reports inline links relying only on color.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise text/control contrast to WCAG thresholds and add a non-color link affordance.

findings.summary: The document has no main landmark.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found header, nav, and footer but no main; Lighthouse explicitly fails landmark-one-main.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap the page’s unique content in a single main landmark and keep heading order aligned to it.

findings.summary: Zoom/reflow usability is weakened by undersized targets.
findings.evidence: The 360px layout reflows without overflow, but Lighthouse target-size fails multiple footer controls at 20px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target dimensions and spacing while preserving the successful narrow reflow.

findings.summary: Image dimensions, resolution, and aspect-ratio handling are unsound.
findings.evidence: The images primitive reports 37 images without dimensions, 11 oversized images, and 30 below-fold images without lazy loading; Lighthouse also finds a logo aspect-ratio mismatch.
findings.suggestedFix: Supply intrinsic dimensions, correct aspect ratios, responsive sources, and lazy loading for below-fold imagery.

findings.summary: One prominent link uses non-descriptive text.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse SEO identifies the support-thread link text “here” as non-descriptive.
findings.suggestedFix: Use destination-specific link text such as “GoonBox support thread”.

findings.summary: Sitemap discovery is inconsistent.
findings.evidence: robots.txt is available and permits the public site, but /sitemap.xml returned HTTP 403 during recon. Canonical metadata is otherwise present.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a crawlable sitemap and reference it from robots.txt; ensure public crawlers receive a successful response.

findings.summary: The public forum home lacks structured entity metadata.
findings.evidence: The probe found five Open Graph tags but zero JSON-LD blocks on a page representing a WebSite/Organization.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org WebSite/Organization JSON-LD matching visible content.

findings.summary: Cookie and transport defenses are materially incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers show no HSTS and a CSP limited to upgrade-insecure-requests. Cookie audit found 8 insecure cookies and SameSite=None on all 8, including a 399-day storage cookie.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure and appropriate SameSite/HttpOnly attributes, deploy HSTS, and replace the minimal CSP with an enforcing allowlist.

findings.summary: Advertising requests collect a broad browser fingerprint without an evident consent step.
findings.evidence: HAR and script evidence show Clickadu requests carrying canvas/WebGL, plugin, platform, screen, language, and other fingerprint fields; 19 third-party requests transfer 776,551 bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove non-essential tracking, gate advertising/analytics behind informed consent where required, and minimize transmitted fields.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policies are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers lack HSTS and Permissions-Policy; CSP has only upgrade-insecure-requests and therefore does not meaningfully restrict script/style origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS, a restrictive CSP including frame-ancestors, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: The layout is hard-wired to physical directions.
findings.evidence: The document declares en-US/ltr, but CSS inspection found 31 margin-left and 20 margin-right usages and no evidence of logical-property adaptation.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace physical spacing/inset properties with logical equivalents and test RTL translation.

findings.summary: Image assets are grossly disproportionate to their rendered purpose.
findings.evidence: HAR shows 6.44MB of images, led by decorative/user embellishments of 2.85MB and 947KB; the images audit finds 42 legacy-format images and 11 oversized images.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate right-sized AVIF/WebP variants, provide srcset/sizes, and avoid loading hidden or below-fold embellishments eagerly.

findings.summary: Background advertising and decoration create avoidable work.
findings.evidence: The page launches multiple asynchronous ad scripts and loads dozens of decorative images during initial navigation, even when they are below the fold.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-essential third-party and decorative work until user intent or idle time, and remove redundant effects.

findings.summary: The third-party and media budget is not proportionate to a forum index.
findings.evidence: The initial page makes 84 requests and transfers 6.71MB, with 19 third-party requests and 776KB third-party bytes before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a route-level byte/request budget and lazy-load non-essential ads, avatars, decorations, and fonts.

Adopt preference-aware and semantic modern interaction patterns
